description: This Java class provides a logging utility that wraps Android's native Log class, allowing for flexible and chainable logging through LogNode objects. It defines log level constants, manages a linked list of LogNodes, and offers methods for logging at various severity levels (verbose, debug, info, warn, error, assert).

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for logging messages at various levels, managing LogNode chains, and serving as a wrapper over Android's native Log class.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current head LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates log message to the current LogNode, passing priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level, optionally with an exception.
